about.title: About
biography: I’m Ricardo, a multidisciplinary digital designer based in Mexico. My background began in Game Design and Art, where I became interested in interaction, 3D and designing experiences. Over time, I focused my work on UX/UI, product design, websites and visual identity.

I’m interested in how an experience works, not only how it looks. I combine research, visual systems, interface design, motion and 3D to turn complex ideas into solutions that feel clear, expressive and useful.
I’m currently collaborating on client projects and developing personal experiences while looking for opportunities in Product Design, UX/UI and digital design.
Outside client work, I explore 3D animation and visual storytelling through personal projects.
